description: Generate comprehensive, high-quality HTML analysis reports from Halliburton DDR.zip archive using template-based extraction for efficiency. Archive contains 3 distinct PDF structure types: (1) Pemex/old-Petroecuador hourly activity tables (14 PDFs, Spanish, 1-2 pages, simple format), (2) Petrobras LIBRA standard DDR (5 PDFs, English/Portuguese, 5-6 pages, detailed with cost sections), (3) Modern Petroecuador operations reports (5 PDFs, English, 1-3 pages, structured format). Create template extractors for each type, then batch process PDFs using appropriate template. Generate professional HTML reports with inline SVG charts and English translations. Do not estimate costs or severity if not explicitly stated in PDFs.

execution_preferences.task_organization: TEMPLATE-BASED APPROACH: (1) First task: Extract archive and identify PDFs by structure type - classify each into Type A (Pemex hourly format), Type B (Petrobras LIBRA DDR), or Type C (Petroecuador operations). (2) Create 3 template development tasks (one per type): analyze 1-2 sample PDFs, identify structure patterns, field locations, and create reusable extraction logic. (3) Create batch processing tasks: Process Type A PDFs (14 PDFs) using Type A template, Process Type B PDFs (5 PDFs) using Type B template, Process Type C PDFs (5 PDFs) using Type C template. (4) Final aggregation task. Total: ~6-8 tasks instead of 26. Prioritize speed through template reuse.

verification_requirements: CRITICAL: Every subtask MUST verify its output files contain real, meaningful data before declaring success. Workers must open and inspect generated files, load actual data samples, check if the data makes sense for the task, and verify it's not just placeholders, boilerplate, or mostly null/zero values. Boss must always include verification as the LAST TODO item for every subtask.
additional_instructions: TEMPLATE-BASED WORKFLOW FOR SPEED: (1) EXTRACT AND CLASSIFY: Extract halliburton_ddr.zip and classify all 24 PDFs into 3 structure types by analyzing first page headers: TYPE A - Pemex Hourly Format (14 PDFs: 11 Pemex + 3 old Petroecuador, Spanish, starts with 'Hrs' column, simple 1-2 page activity tables), TYPE B - Petrobras LIBRA DDR (5 PDFs: all Petrobras, English/Portuguese, 5-6 pages, starts with 'Daily Drilling Report (LIBRA)', has cost sections), TYPE C - Modern Petroecuador (5 PDFs: 2023 Petroecuador, English, 1-3 pages, starts with 'DAILY OPERATIONS' and 'EP PETROECUADOR'). Create outputs/pdf_classification.json mapping each PDF to its type. (2) DEVELOP 3 TEMPLATES: For each type, analyze 1-2 sample PDFs to create reusable extraction templates defining: field locations (headers, metadata, cost tables), data patterns, translation rules, HTML section templates. Save as outputs/template_typeA.json, outputs/template_typeB.json, outputs/template_typeC.json. (3) BATCH PROCESS USING TEMPLATES: Create ONE task per type that processes ALL PDFs of that type using the template (14 Type A PDFs in one task, 5 Type B PDFs in one task, 5 Type C PDFs in one task). For each PDF generate TWO files: (a) PROFESSIONAL HTML REPORT: detailed_report_<pdfname>.html - CRITICAL STYLING REQUIREMENTS: Use modern, professional CSS with gradient backgrounds, card-based layouts, responsive design, proper typography (font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif), color-coded sections, hover effects, box-shadows, and polished visual hierarchy. Use INLINE SVG CHARTS (bar charts, line charts, pie charts, timelines) with proper scales, labels, legends, and color schemes. ALL CONTENT IN ENGLISH (translate from any source language). DO NOT include raw PDF text - only analyzed, summarized, and visualized data. Required sections to discover and create: [Executive Summary: concise overview of key findings], [Document Metadata: extract any header info - dates, IDs, names found in PDF], [COST INFORMATION: search for any cost/financial data in tables or text - extract exact values with currency, create visual cost breakdown chart if multiple cost types found], [Key Metrics Dashboard: visual cards showing discovered numerical metrics with units], [Events Analysis: discover and categorize any events/incidents/issues mentioned, translate descriptions, show duration/impact if available, create timeline visualization], [Operations Summary: discover activities/operations, translate to English, create activity breakdown chart], [Data Tables: present any tabular data found in clean, sortable HTML tables with alternating row colors], [Visual Analytics: create 3-5 inline SVG charts based on discovered data - trends, comparisons, distributions]. Embed ALL styling in <style> tags. Use professional color palette (blues: #3498db, #2c3e50; greens: #2ecc71; reds: #e74c3c; grays: #ecf0f1, #95a5a6). Add responsive meta tags. NO external dependencies. (b) STRUCTURED JSON: summary_<pdfname>.json - Discover and extract structured data dynamically based on PDF content. Flexible schema: {"metadata": {"discovered_fields": {...}}, "costs": {"discovered_cost_fields": {...}, "currency": "..." or null}, "events": [{"type": "discovered event type", "description_en": "English translation", "metrics": {...}}], "operations": [{"description_en": "English translation", "metrics": {...}}], "key_metrics": {"discovered_metrics": {...}}, "summaries": {"english_summary": "...", "key_findings_en": [...]}}. (3) AGGREGATE MASTER REPORT (1 task): Read ALL JSON summaries and create a STUNNING index.html - PROFESSIONAL ENTERPRISE-LEVEL HTML with EMBEDDED CSS and INLINE SVG CHARTS. STYLING: Modern gradient header, card-based layout, responsive grid system, professional color scheme, smooth animations, polished typography, interactive hover effects. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT - EVENTS AND COST ANALYSIS TABLE: Comprehensive sortable table titled 'Events and Cost Analysis' with columns: [Date, Operator, Rig, Well, Event Type, Event Description (English), Duration/Count, Cost Impact, Source Report Link]. Aggregate ALL discovered events from all PDFs. Sort by cost impact (highest first), then date. Include summary rows: Total Events by Type, Total Cost Impact by Operator, Total Cost Impact by Event Type. Use color-coding for event types. Additional sections with INLINE SVG VISUALIZATIONS: [Executive Dashboard: 4-6 metric cards with key statistics], [Cost Overview: detailed cost breakdown with stacked bar chart by operator, pie chart by cost type, trend line if temporal data exists], [Events Analysis: interactive table + bar chart showing event frequency by type, severity distribution], [Operations Summary: timeline visualization, activity breakdown chart], [Comparative Analysis: multi-series charts comparing operators across metrics], [Detailed Data Tables: sortable, filterable tables with all discovered data]. ALL charts must be inline SVG with proper scales, axes, labels, legends, and professional styling. ALL text in English. Self-contained - works offline when double-clicked. CRITICAL: Extract ONLY actual data from PDFs. Translate all non-English text. DO NOT estimate or fabricate data. Mark missing data as 'N/A'. DO NOT include raw PDF content - only analyzed, visualized insights.
